description: Defines the WKProvisionalPage class which manages network requests and frame handling for a WebKit page in the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: WKProvisionalPage
classes.description: Manages network requests, frame attachment, and event handling for a WebKit page during provisional navigation.

methods.name: coopNavigationRequest
methods.description: Returns the current provisional navigation request, if any.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes event listeners associated with this provisional page.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Attaches the provisional page's main frame to the page.

methods.name: _onRequestWillBeSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a network request is about to be sent.

methods.name: _onLoadingFinished
methods.description: Handles the event when loading finishes.

methods.name: _onLoadingFailed
methods.description: Handles the event when loading fails.

methods.name: _handleFrameTree
methods.description: Processes the frame tree to identify the main frame ID.
